## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Olympia, United States. It starts at 2702 East D Street.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Start your engines and step on the gas with your tickets to **LeMay - America's Car Museum** in Tacoma.
>
> Perfect for motorheads and dabblers alike, you'll see world-class rotating exhibitions featuring **classic cars spanning 100 years** of automotive innovation.
>
> See what's under the hood on over **300 foreign and domestic vehicles** curated by Harold and Nancy LeMay – the **world’s largest privately-owned collection of automobiles and automotive memorabilia.**

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €24.89. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 30 ratings and 15 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
